blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.
\R. And with your spirit.

blocks.text: Fidélium, Deus, véniae largitor et humánae salútis amátor: quǽsumus cleméntiam tuam; ut nostræ congregatiónis fratres, propínquos et benefactóres, qui ex hoc sǽculo transiérunt, beáta María semper Vírgine intercedénte cum ómnibus Sanctis tuis, ad perpétuæ beatitúdinis consórtium perveníre concédas. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus,...
blocks.translation: O God, the forgiver of sins and the lover of human salvation, we beseech Thy clemency: that the brothers, relations, and benefactors of our congregation who have passed out of this world, may, through the intercession of Blessed Mary ever-Virgin and all Thy Saints, attain to the fellowship of eternal blessedness. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,...

blocks.text: In diébus illis: Audívi vocem de cœlo, dicéntem mihi: Scribe: Beáti mórtui, qui in Dómino moriúntur. Amodo iam dicit Spíritus, ut requiéscant a labóribus suis: ópera enim illórum sequúntur illos.
blocks.translation: In those days, I heard a voice from heaven saying to me: "Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord. From henceforth, says the Spirit, let them rest from their labours, for their works follow them."

blocks.chantTranslation:
_4 Esdras 2:34–35_//Grant them eternal rest, O Lord,
and let perpetual light//shine upon them.

_Psalm 111:7_  The righteous shall be held in everlasting remembrance:

he shall not fear evil tidings.

Absolve, O Lord, the souls//of all the faithful departed//from every bond of sin.

And, with the help of your grace,//may they deserve to escape//the judgment of punishment.

And enjoy the blessedness//of everlasting light.

blocks.chantTranslation:
Day of wrath, that day will// dissolve the world into ashes,//as David and the Sibyl bear witness.
What trembling there shall be,//when the Judge shall come,//to examine all things strictly!
The trumpet,//scattering its wondrous sound
through the tombs of every land,//shall summon all before the throne.
Death and nature shall stand amazed,//when creation rises again//to answer to the Judge.
The written book//shall be brought forth,//in which all things are contained,
from which the world shall be judged.//When therefore the Judge shall sit,
whatever is hidden shall appear://nothing shall remain unpunished.
What then shall I, wretched man, say?//What advocate shall I seek,//when even the righteous
scarcely stand secure?//King of dreadful majesty,//who freely save those
worthy of salvation,//save me, O fountain of mercy.//Remember, loving Jesus,
that I am the reason//for your earthly journey://do not lose me on that day.
Seeking me, you sat down weary;//suffering the Cross, you redeemed me://let such labour not be in vain.
Just Judge of vengeance,//grant the gift of pardon//before the day of reckoning.
I groan as one guilty;//my face reddens with shame//for my sins:
spare your suppliant, O God.//You who absolved Mary,
and heard the thief,//have given hope to me also.
My prayers are not worthy://but you, who are good,
deal kindly with me,//lest I burn in everlasting fire.//Grant me a place among the sheep,
and separate me from the goats,//setting me at your right hand.
When the accursed//have been confounded,//and consigned to bitter flames,//call me among the blessed.
I pray, bowed down in supplication,//my heart crushed as ashes:
take care of my final end.//That day shall be one of tears,
when guilty man//shall rise from the ashes//to be judged.
Therefore spare him, O God://merciful Lord Jesus,//grant them rest. Amen.

blocks.text: In illo témpore: Dixit Iesus turbis Iudæórum: Ego sum panis vivus, qui de cœlo descéndi. Si quis manducáverit ex hoc pane, vivet in ætérnum: et panis, quem ego dabo, caro mea est pro mundi vita. Litigábant ergo Iudǽi ad ínvicem, dicéntes: Quómodo potest hic nobis carnem suam dare ad manducándum? Dixit ergo eis Iesus: Amen, amen, dico vobis: nisi manducavéritis carnem Fílii hóminis et bibéritis eius sánguinem, non habébitis vitam in vobis. Qui mánducat meam carnem et bibit meum sánguinem, habet vitam ætérnam: et ego resuscitábo eum in novíssimo die.
blocks.translation: At that time, Jesus said to the crowds of the Jews: "I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he shall live for ever; and the bread that I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world." The Jews therefore disputed among themselves, saying: "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?" Jesus therefore said to them: "Amen, amen, I say to you: unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you shall not have life in you. He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day."

blocks.text:
Dómine Iesu Christe, Rex glóriæ, líbera ánimas ómnium fidélium defunctórum de pœnis inférni et de profúndo lacu: líbera eas de ore leónis, ne absórbeat eas tártarus, ne cadant in obscúrum: sed sígnifer sanctus Míchaël repræséntet eas in lucem sanctam: Quam olim Abrahæ promisísti et sémini eius.

Hóstias et preces tibi, Dómine, laudis offérimus: tu súscipe pro animábus illis, quarum hódie memóriam fácimus: fac eas, Dómine, de morte transíre ad vitam. Quam olim Abrahæ promisísti et sémini eius.
blocks.translation:
Lord Jesus Christ, King of glory, deliver the souls of all the faithful departed from the pains of hell and from the deep pit; deliver them from the lion’s mouth, lest Tartarus swallow them up, lest they fall into darkness: but may the standard-bearer, holy Michael, bring them into the holy light, which you once promised to Abraham and his seed.

We offer you, O Lord, sacrifices and prayers of praise: receive them for those souls whom we remember this day; grant, O Lord, that they may pass from death into life, which you once promised to Abraham and his seed.

blocks.text: Deus, cuius misericórdieæ non est númerus, súscipe propítius preces  humilitátis nostræ: et animábus fratrum, propinquórum, et benefactórum nostrórum, quibus tui nóminis dedísti confessiónem, per hæc sacraménta  salutis nostræ, cunctorum remissiónem tríbue peccatórum. Per  Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et  regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus,...
blocks.translation: O God, whose mercy is without number, graciously hear the prayers of our humility; and grant to the souls of our brothers, relatives, and benefactors, to whom you granted confession of your name, through these sacraments of our salvation, the remission of all sins. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,...

blocks.text: Vere dignum et iustum est, æquum et salutáre, nos tibi semper et  ubíque grátias ágere: Dómine sancte, Pater omnípotens, ætérne Deus:  per Christum Dóminum nostrum. In quo nobis spes beátæ resurrectiónis  effúlsit, ut quos contrístat certa moriéndi condítio, eósdem consolétur  futúræ immortalitátis promíssio. Tuis enim fidélibus, Dómine, vita  mutátur, non tóllitur, et dissolúta terréstris huius incolátus dómo, ætérna  in cælis habitátio comparátur. Et ídeo cum Ángelis et Archángelis, cum  Thronis et Dominatiónibus, cumque omni milítia cæléstis exércitus,  hymnum glóriæ tuæ cánimus sine fine dicéntes:
blocks.translation: It is truly right and just, fitting and salutary, that we should always and everywhere give thanks to you, O holy Lord, almighty Father, eternal God, through Christ our Lord. In him the hope of blessed resurrection has shone forth for us, so that those whom the certainty of dying makes sorrowful may be consoled by the promise of future immortality. For to your faithful people, O Lord, life is changed, not taken away, and when the dwelling of this earthly sojourn is dissolved, an eternal dwelling is prepared in heaven. And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominions, and with all the hosts of the heavenly army, we sing the hymn of your glory, ever saying:

blocks.text:
Præcéptis salutáribus móniti, et divína institutióne formáti audémus dícere:

Pater noster, qui es in cælis. Sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie. Et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris…
blocks.translation:
At the Saviour's command and formed by divine teaching, we dare to say:

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name; thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us...

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. …and lead us not into temptation
\R. but deliver us from evil..

blocks.text: Líbera nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, ab ómnibus malis, prætéritis, præséntibus et futúris: et intercedénte beáta et gloriósa semper Vírgine Dei Genetríce María, cum beátis Apóstolis tuis Petro et Paulo, atque Andréa, et ómnibus Sanctis, da propítius pacem in diébus nostris: ut, ope misericórdiæ tuæ adiúti, et a peccáto simus semper líberi et ab omni perturbatióne secúri. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus…
blocks.translation: Deliver us, Lord, we pray, from every evil, past, present and to come, and, through the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-Virgin Mary, Mother of God, with your blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and Andrew, and all the Saints, graciously grant peace in our days, that, by the help of your mercy, we may be always free from sin and safe from all distress. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,…

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The peace of the Lord//be with you always.
\R. And with your spirit.

blocks.text: \V. Panem cæléstem accípiam, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
blocks.translation: \V. I will take the Bread of heaven, and will call upon the Name of the Lord.

blocks.text: \R. Dómine, non sum dignus, ut intres sub tectum meum: sed tantum dic verbo, et sanábitur ánima mea.
blocks.translation: \R. Lord, I am not worthy that Thou shouldst enter under my roof; say but the word, and my soul shall be healed.

blocks.text: Lux ætérna lúceat eis, Dómine, Cum Sanctis tuis in ætérnum: quia pius es. Requiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine: et lux perpétua lúceat eis. Cum Sanctis tuis in ætérnum: quia pius es.
blocks.translation: May eternal light shine upon them, O Lord: * with your saints for ever, because you are merciful. Grant them eternal rest, O Lord: * and let perpetual light shine upon them. With your saints for ever: * because you are merciful.

blocks.text: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis, et perícula inférni invenérunt me. In tribulatióne mea invocávi Dóminum et a Deum meum clamávi.
blocks.translation: The sorrows of death have compassed me: and the perils of hell have found me. In my trouble, I called upon the Lord and cried out to my God.

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.
\R. And with your spirit.

blocks.text: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens et miséricors Deus: ut ánimæ fratrum,  propinquórum, et benefactórum nostrórum, pro quibus hoc sacrifícium  laudis tuæ obtúlimus maiestáti: per huius virtútem sacraménti a peccátis ómnibus expiátæ, lucis perpétuæ, te miseránte, recípiant beatúdinem.  Per Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et  regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus,...
blocks.translation: Grant, we beseech you, almighty and merciful God, that the souls of our brothers, relatives, and benefactors, for whom we have offered this sacrifice of your praise to your majesty, may, by the power of this sacrament, be cleansed from all sins, and through your mercy receive everlasting light and blessedness. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,...

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.
\R. And with your spirit.

\V. May they rest in peace.
\R. Amen.

blocks.text:
Líbera me, Dómine,  de morte ætérna in die illa treménda, quando cœli movéndi sunt et terra; dum véneris iudicáre  sǽculum per ignem.

Tremens factus sum ego,  et tímeo,  dum discússio vénerit  atque ventúra ira. Dies illa, dies iræ,  calamitátis et misériæ, dies magna et amara valde. Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine; et lux perpétua lucéat eis.

Kýrie eléison. Christe eléison. Kýrie eléison.
blocks.translation:
Deliver me, O Lord, from eternal death on that dreadful day, when the heavens and the earth shall be shaken; when you shall come to judge the world by fire.

I tremble and I fear, until the examination comes, and the coming wrath. That day, a day of wrath, of calamity and misery, a great day and most bitter indeed. Grant them eternal rest, O Lord; and let perpetual light shine upon them.

Lord have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy.

blocks.text: Dimítte me ergo, ut plangam páululum dolórem meum: ántequam vadam, et non revértar, ad terram tenebrósam et opértam mortis calígine.
blocks.translation: Let me then be, that I may weep a little for my sorrow, before I go and shall not return, to the land of darkness and shadowed by the gloom of death.
